# AUDR fixtures

From https://github.com/openaudr/audr at commit
`95213e30568d4ffcdb4b6861358676778d9d8fd1` (spec v1.0.0):

- `conformance/` and `cases.json` — the language-neutral conformance suite,
  copied without modification.
- `multi-emitter-run.jsonl` — the four records of
  `spec/examples/multi-emitter-run/*.json`, one per line (re-serialized as JSONL,
  values unchanged).
